cases.public_problem: Environment-variable flag values must distinguish activation from deactivation. False-like values must not activate non-boolean flags; true-like values and the exact flag_value activate them. Boolean flag values containing only whitespace represent false. Preserve explicit command-line activation and normal argument conversion.
